assumptions.instruction: Allocate a SMALL fixed-size buffer (e.g. 'char buf[64]'). Do NOT allocate 4096 bytes.
assumptions.rationale: We need the symbolic length (up to 4096) to EXCEED the allocation size to force an out-of-bounds READ at the target.

assumptions.instruction: Do NOT add safety-coupling assumptions that constrain the bug-driving length in the target (e.g., 'len < sizeof(target_buf)'). Exception: Harness-local safety bounds (BUF[len]) are permitted.
assumptions.rationale: Target safety-coupling can hide the bug and invalidate confirmation.

assumptions.instruction: Do NOT add new loops over symbolic arrays to enforce non-null characters. If you need a terminator, set 'buf[sizeof(buf)-1] = 0'.
assumptions.rationale: New loops over symbolic arrays cause combinatorial path growth; preserve only program-required loops.
